text:
If you don't like reading a lot, here's a short review: 1. The dentists (whether for root canal treatment, crowns, scaling, or retainers) are skilled, meticulous, kind, lovely, and beautiful.
2. The staff are lovely, attentive, polite, mature, and definitely not rude. They're also beautiful. 3. The place is clean, bright, and quiet. There's complimentary drinking water, milk, and fresh coffee. There's parking available.
If you like reading a lot and want a complete review, please read the full review below. I've intended to write this review many times, but my review style requires a complete account of my experience, so I haven't had the time. Haha. Today, I'll keep my promise.
Around the end of 2024, I had terrible tooth pain, like the worst possible. I was also busy with several exams and couldn't study. So I tried to find a dental clinic urgently. My regular dentist at the time was unavailable, no matter how much I tried to get an appointment. So I searched on Google and found this clinic near my house with pretty good reviews. That's why I went to this dentist, and after that, I never went back to my first regular clinic again. No matter how close it is (555555555555), we'll share our experience in detail, one thing at a time, in case it's helpful for those looking for emergency dental care like us.
1. The staff is incredibly lovely. Five stars!
When I called, the queue was long, but I left a message on LINE saying that if there was an earlier appointment, please let me know. The staff were incredibly lovely, answered my questions in detail, and even remembered my case (I guess I waited for the appointment for ages!). It turned out that before my appointment, the staff messaged me to schedule my visit. Thank you for remembering me! It was a lifesaver! I was so happy because I had been in pain for almost a week. After that, I continued to go to this dental clinic, and I found that both of the staff (the two I saw most often) were lovely. They were polite, friendly, mature, and had excellent emotional control.
2. The doctor is lovely, kind, and has a gentle touch. Five stars!
On my next visit, I was very impressed. Dr. Oranusa said that if the toothache was severe, it was possible I might need root canal treatment. She asked if I wanted root canal treatment right away, as she could call a root canal specialist that day. I really wanted root canal treatment, but I had an exam in the afternoon, so I scheduled it for another day and endured the pain while taking my exam. But it was truly impressive because everyone here tried their best to help us, even though we were new here.
3. Root Canal Treatment and Crowns: Five stars.
Regarding price, to be honest, we've had root canal treatment much cheaper elsewhere.
However, in terms of skill, we rank this place number one. The attentiveness, meticulousness, and gentle touch of the dentist here are exceptional. During the root canal treatment, it felt incredibly clean and thorough, meticulously cleaning all four of our root canals (this is just my feeling, not based on scientific evidence).
One of the most important things is that after the root canal treatment, we experienced no pain, no discomfort, and no side effects at all. This is different from the previous clinic we went to, where we experienced pain at the treatment site for about two weeks (which we thought was normal for root canal treatment).
Therefore, in terms of gentleness and meticulousness, we give this place the top spot. The price is a bit higher, but honestly, if you compare the average price of root canal treatment across all clinics, this place is in the affordable to mid-range price range.
The crowns are also different people; the root canal specialist and the crown specialist are different individuals. The dentist for the crown is Dr. Oranusa, who is very meticulous and kind.
I also had tartar removed by another dentist, who was also kind and lovely.
In short, all the dentists are skilled, lovely, and meticulous.
4. Making a new retainer to correct the gaps between my teeth, which is now back together. Five stars.
After the root canal treatment, I had another dental problem. I had braces for many years, and lately I haven't been diligent in wearing my retainer, so my teeth shifted. This shifting affected my front teeth, causing a gap that many people commented on. So I consulted the dentist. The dentist suggested trying a new retainer, but if my front teeth didn't close up again, I would need braces again. I trusted the dentist and got a retainer, trying to wear it consistently. Now my front teeth are back together again. I'm very happy. But the dentist also advised me to practice swallowing saliva again because I swallow like a child (haha, so embarrassing).
5. The place is clean, with drinking water and coffee available (the staff served water every time I came to see the dentist, which was very nice, but I think I could have gotten it myself too). There is parking available. Five stars.
As mentioned above, I think this is a sufficiently detailed review for what I can remember. Hopefully, this will be helpful to many people who are looking for a good and lovely dental clinic to become their regular clinic like we were.
Thank you very much to the team of doctors and staff. If you read this, I hope this message will be an encouragement for you to continue maintaining such good things, like salt preserves its flavor.

text: The doctor's clinic is across from my village, so I've seen it for a long time. My family, including my siblings and nieces and nephews, are all his clients.
